ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $6.61 cancellation fee; close the dispute with the $6.61 / $5.00 voucher-window and 30-day appeal note if re-raised.

rejected_claims.reason: A change of plans is not a ground to waive the cancellation fee under NS-4; the fee attaches to cancelling more than 3 minutes after matching (6:40 elapsed).

Driver non-arrival is not a published ground for free cancellation (Ryde has no ETA-based waiver; NS-8 is informational only). GPS in fact places the driver at the pickup from 08:42:00, before the 08:46:40 cancellation.
